I really enjoyed the Watchmen and just recently finished Preacher which I also thoroughly enjoyed. Could anyone here suggest some similar series I could check out?
I'm not a huge comic fan but I'd like some recommendations

Y: The Last Man is a strong favorite of mine. Earlier project from the same dude that writes Saga. All the males on earth have died out for some reason except for this one dude. Looks at the last man on earth scenario in a pretty interesting way.

Also check out Transmetropolitan. Follows a journalist in the relatively near future who covers the bullshit of the government and daily life in general. It's set forward enough that it doesn't seem heavy handed with its social commentary but not so far that its unrelateable. Spider Jerusalem is just a great goddamn character too.

Lastly, I think you might like Irredeemable. It's about a Superman-type called the Plutonian and is basically about what would happen if an all powerful super hero decided to stop helping people and be a bad guy. Number of DC storylines have done this with actual Superman now but this was a pretty cool take on it while not actually being in the DC universe.

All three of these are fully finished and about 10-12 volumes. They're all pretty popular so your local shop should have them in stock but if not, Barnes & Nobel might have some volumes, Amazon obviously will, and they're all on Comixology if you wanted to go digital. check out v/comicbooks too if you want more recommendations.
